title: Geometric coordinate flags: conditional κ = 5.1428783626028e-5
body:
This gives a finite conditional witness with **κ = 12857195906507 / 250000000000000000 = 5.1428783626028×10⁻⁵**, approximately **0.02750% above PR71**. It also exceeds PR75's reported 5.14154245470094×10⁻⁵. The bit saving is **25715714341 / 500000000000000**.

**Geometric change:** optimize the coordinate flag of PR71's existing physical words. A coordinate permutation commutes with I+J and preserves I−J/9. Relabeling all source triples, outputs, frame masks and scatter indices preserves the circuit, every containment and the complete data-case multiset. It changes which adjacent pivots form recursive blocks in internal transition profiles.

Roles remain **27,455 / 36,015**, width remains **135,075,665**, and the literal role operations, paid clearing, endpoint corrections and total recursive rank remain unchanged. Both words are regenerated from the pinned PR71 words by the explicit selected permutations; the general relabeling argument is in `research/coordinate-flags/README.md`.

**Focused verification passed:** byte-for-byte word reconstruction, full ordinary-input and arbitrary-dirty-basis replay in both orientations, independent transition reconstruction, complete fixed-I+J profiles with the inherited exact CRT bounds, all 47 strict constraints and seven margins, independent rational moment bounds, both next-grid rejections, exclusion of PR71's complete profile, and six negative controls. Run `make coordinate-flags-verify`.

**Full verification completed.** All expanded `make verify` groups are covered by the recorded original and resumed runs, followed by the new focused checks (80 isolated test modules; 6 new controls). The first run stopped at a local Apple Clang OpenMP configuration error; the failed group and every remaining group passed after enabling installed libomp. No checks were bypassed. Receipt: `research/coordinate-flags/validation.json`. All 39 GitHub checks passed on the validated research/packaging head; this follow-up commit only adds the receipt. The new verifier is included in the sequential full target and the Python 3.11/3.13/3.14 CI matrix. Root-document source pins and derived digests are refreshed for the inherited joint/split packages; their numerical certificates are unchanged.

This is a finite conditional bound under the inherited all-size compiler, routing, prime selection, exact recovery, finite-alphabet/fixed-tape and analytic-transfer hypotheses. The bounded coordinate search establishes neither global optimality nor measured practical speedup.
